newsitem.title: USA: Tandy Q1 net affected by strategy shifts.
newsitem.headline: Tandy Q1 net affected by strategy shifts.

text.p: Tandy Corp said Wednesday its first quarter earnings were affected by a planned shift in promotional strategy at its Radio Shack stores and a sales strategy change at its Computer City franchise.
Earlier, Tandy reported first quarter operating earnings were $0.60 a share compared with $0.48 a share last year.
Net income for the the current quarter was $0.43 a share after a $0.17 per share charge associated with the cost of exiting its Incredible Universe business.
Tandy said its results were affected by a change in strategy at its Radio Shack stores as the retail business began to focus on its new telecommunications strategy.
The company also said profits at its Computer City unit exceeded those of the previous year as strategies directed towards repeat customer were implemented.
Tandy sells its products through 6,800 RadioShack and 93 Computer City outlets.
